elements_not_encoded.text: If temperature ≥ 38°C or meningitis likely: give ceftriaxone1 2g IM. Avoid injecting > 1g IM at one injection site. If referral delayed, repeat ceftriaxone1 2g
elements_not_encoded.reason: Ceftriaxone/analgesia doses and referral; meningitis likely is encoded from the red-box criterion

elements_not_encoded.text: If fever now or in past 3 days, and in a malaria area in past 3 months, malaria likely 39.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Malaria likely needs "in a malaria area in past 3 months": no SNOMED concept for exposure to a malaria area; malaria rule not encoded (page 39 handles malaria)

judgment_calls.decision: Encoded as SBP >= 180 or DBP >= 110 without the 'not pregnant' clause
judgment_calls.alternatives: (not Pregnancy) is rejected by VHA's evidence code; (no Pregnancy) needs an explicit No and would miss men. A pregnant patient with BP >= 180/110 already meets the 140/90 line, so the urgent outcome is identical

judgment_calls.decision: Headache + Chronic persistent qualifier AND a Procedure finding of Highly active antiretroviral therapy
judgment_calls.alternatives: HIV infection (a proxy, rejected); leaving the item out

judgment_calls.decision: Probable GCA on Temporal headache alone; age > 50 is not representable, so the rule fires more often than the page intends
Not encoded: no concept for having been in a malaria area
Red-box task and flowchart task, both triggered by Headache
African tick bite fever (closest to the page's words 'tick bite fever')
judgment_calls.alternatives: Spotted fever group rickettsial disease (builder A; broader, also covers Boutonneuse fever)

judgment_calls.decision: Possible Acute viral disease when Q0 = Yes, the sinusitis branch is recorded absent and there is no tick bite
judgment_calls.alternatives: Not encoded, as management only (builder A)

judgment_calls.decision: No Sudden onset qualifier: 'New sudden' sits before the weakness/numbness clause and the semicolon
judgment_calls.alternatives: Sudden onset on Difficulty talking (builder B)

judgment_calls.decision: Nasal discharge + Thick and Posterior rhinorrhea + Thick (page's word 'thick')
